description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
